title: Discurso del Sr. Presidente Rojas Pinilla en la inauguración de las escuelas radiofónicas de Sutatenza
version: Señal Memoria, 16 February 2015, identifying CD8409 and CD8136 copies from its collection of speeches.
lineage: Separate sound record of the same state ceremony as the ODIPE film. The archive states that the two CD catalogue records are copies of the same speech. The catalogue quotation was inspected.

passages.quote: en la inauguración de las escuelas radiofónicas de Sutatenza – 7-NOV-1954
passages.note: Confirms the ceremony date, locality and presidential speech. The film catalogue describes which equipment the ceremony inaugurated.
